comparison.objective: Twist an ice tray to release cubes, tip them into a dish, and replace the tray; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR applies opposing bimanual torques and pours multiple loose objects. Candidate performs small-socket tool use, fine collar rotation, relocking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires a qualifying 12° twist, all eight cubes in the dish, and tray replacement. Candidate requires two bounded dynamic stops with no damage or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Opposing-torque flexing and pouring do not test precision fastener access or dynamic commissioning.
